title: The Advanced Companion to Blood Currents
summary: A companion for those past the courses that raises the long blood current to a flood and a mantle that feeds the user through a hard fight.

title: A Master's Treatise on the Binding Pulse
summary: A treatise on holds that still the blood of a limb and then the whole body so the opponent is moved like a puppet.

title: The Canon of the Restarted Heart
summary: A canon of the healing hand that clears poison and curse from the blood and restarts a heart that has just stopped.

title: The Paired Pulse Canon
summary: A canon of dual-track blood work where two pulses are kept in step so that every strike and guard comes as a matched pair.

title: A Twin-Court Treatise on Warding Blood
summary: A treatise on guarding in pairs where two bodies share one thickened pulse so that a blow aimed at one is spread across both.

title: The Hawk's Vein Manual
summary: A manual in the way of the hawk that hunts by the pulse of its quarry and dives in one stroke to end a chase.

title: The Oath-Bearing Blood Book
summary: A book of vows made in blood that teaches how a sworn word is bound into the pulse and held there against a foe.

title: A Windward Reckoning of the Pulse
summary: A reckoning of the pulse taken at speed that keeps blood and wind in one stride and drives blows along the line of travel.

title: A Treatise on the Oath-Held Current
summary: A treatise on a current of blood held under oath that never breaks its bearing and needs no wall to stand against a charge.
